_comment: PRIOR-RESIDUAL CENSUS (docs/SPEC_prior_residual_census.md) -- 305-station
SCALING smoke, 0.25 h of data (900 s = 30 epochs at 30 s).
Extends _agu305_gps_smoke.json, so the posture is the AGU26 305-station arm
verbatim: roster 305 -> 303 (WTZZ00DEU + OBE400DEU held out), GPS-only, SH
degree 8 dual-shell, PD-safe fold + D5 v3 + adm_screen + the Jul-28 armed set,
and network.lane_carry.enable FALSE (the measured 12x arm: applyLaneMeasurement
is 84.7 % of a 305-station run's wall and buys nothing on DOY-129).  The ONLY
deltas are the duration and the census knobs.
WHY 305 AND NOT 63.  The card's section 5 cost claim is stated at 63 stations
(<= 1 ms/epoch, measured 0.14).  The census is O(carried priors), and the
carried-prior population is the thing that scales with the roster -- so this arm
is the cost claim's actual falsifier.  Section 5 also pre-commits the response:
above 5 ms/epoch something is wrong with the IMPLEMENTATION, not with the
estimate, and the report says so rather than adding a stride.  There is no
stride knob in v1 and this run is not permitted to invent one.
Corroboration is ON (the arm extends the FT63 corrob posture in spirit) so one
run exercises every path: the five feeds, both dispersion branches, all three
labels, the ladder, the trace, the PRIORRES events, the epoch-status columns,
the contingency join and the run-end readout.
WHAT 30 EPOCHS CAN AND CANNOT ESTABLISH.  This is a COLD window and section 9's
convergence hygiene applies unchanged: it establishes LIVE WIRING (gate 2 --
non-zero n_rows per armed family, with the run-end line separating 'ran, saw
nothing' from 'never ran') and COST (gate 7) at 305 stations, and nothing else.
Do NOT quote a ladder occupancy from it: sigma0 needs 200 rows per family to
leave warm-up (every t below that is the RAW FORMAL s and flagged as such), and
the whole window sits inside ignition, where a free ambiguity absorbs its own
arc's misfit exactly.  Gates 3-6 need a converged warm leg.
NO OFF CONTROL IS PAIRED WITH THIS ARM by instruction, so gate 1 (OFF
byte-identity) is NOT graded here -- it was graded on the 63-station pair
(_ft63_prires_smoke vs _ft63_prires_smoke_off) and the card's OFF contract is
structural, not roster-dependent.
